<style>
html, body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  height: 100%;
  width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, sans-serif;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

#left-box {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 170px;
  height: calc(100vh - 100px); /* Subtract bottom bar height */
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2c3e50 0%, #34495e 100%);
  border-right: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  padding-top: 0px;
  z-index: 100; /* Higher than menu but lower than file tab */
  box-shadow: 4px 0 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
  overflow-y: auto;
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);

  /* Hide scrollbar visually */
  -ms-overflow-style: none;  /* IE/Edge */
  scrollbar-width: none;     /* Firefox */
}

#left-box::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none; /* Chrome/Safari/Edge */
}

#page-label {
  width: 100px;
  height: 35px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
  border-radius: 8px;
  margin: 15px 10px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  color: white;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.3);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
}

.sidebar-button {
  width: 150px;
  height: 35px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4a5568 0%, #2d3748 100%);
  border-radius: 8px;
  margin: 3px 10px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.sidebar-button::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: -100%;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2), transparent);
  transition: left 0.5s;
}

.sidebar-button:hover::before {
  left: 100%;
}

.sidebar-button:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.4);
  color: white;
}

.sidebar-button:active {
  transform: translateY(0px);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}

#bottom-bar {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2c3e50 0%, #34495e 100%);
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  box-shadow: 0 -4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding-left: 130px;
  padding-right: 120px; /* Enough space to avoid trash can */
  z-index: 2;
  overflow: hidden; /* Hide scrollbars */
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}

#page-buttons {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  overflow-x: auto;
  overflow-y: hidden;
  padding-right: 180px; /* Prevents pages from going under trash can */
  scrollbar-width: none; /* Firefox */
  -ms-overflow-style: none; /* IE/Edge */
  gap: 8px;
}
#page-buttons::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none; /* Chrome/Safari */
}

.page-button {
  min-width: 65px;
  height: 65px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4a5568 0%, #2d3748 100%);
  border-radius: 14px;
  margin: 0 2px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  color: white;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  user-select: none;
  /* Enable dragging for page buttons specifically */
  -webkit-user-drag: element;
  /* Allow pointer events for dragging */
  pointer-events: auto;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.page-button::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: -100%;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), transparent);
  transition: left 0.5s;
}

.page-button:hover::before {
  left: 100%;
}

.page-button:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.4);
}

.page-button.selected {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
  color: white;
  font-weight: 700;
  box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.6);
  border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

.page-button.dragging {
  cursor: grabbing;
  opacity: 0.8;
  transform: scale(1.1) rotate(2deg);
  z-index: 1000;
  /* Maintain dragging capability during drag state */
  -webkit-user-drag: element;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

#trash-can {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 20px;
  right: 20px;
  width: 65px;
  height: 65px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e74c3c 0%, #c0392b 100%);
  border-radius: 14px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  color: white;
  font-size: 26px;
  font-weight: bold;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  z-index: 10;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(231, 76, 60, 0.3);
}

#trash-can:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff6b6b 0%, #ee5a52 100%);
  transform: scale(1.05);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(231, 76, 60, 0.5);
}

#trash-can.drag-over {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff6b6b 0%, #ee5a52 100%);
  border: 2px solid #fff;
  animation: trashPulse 0.6s infinite;
  box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.8);
}

@keyframes trashPulse {
  0% { transform: scale(1.05); }
  50% { transform: scale(1.15); }
  100% { transform: scale(1.05); }
}

.page-button.to-delete {
  border: 3px dashed #e74c3c !important;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e74c3c 0%, #c0392b 100%) !important;
  animation: deleteWarning 1s infinite;
}

@keyframes deleteWarning {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
  50% { opacity: 0.7; }
}

#corner-box {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 120px;
  height: 100px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2c3e50 0%, #34495e 100%);
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  z-index: 3;
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}

#corner-button {
  width: 100px;
  height: 35px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4a5568 0%, #2d3748 100%);
  border-radius: 8px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

#corner-button::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: -100%;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2), transparent);
  transition: left 0.5s;
}

#corner-button:hover::before {
  left: 100%;
}

#corner-button:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.4);
  color: white;
}

#scene-area {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f5f7fa 0%, #c3cfe2 100%);
  display: flex;
}

#canvas-wrapper {
  width: 1365px;
  height: calc(100vh - 100px); /* Full height minus bottom bar */
  transform-origin: 0 0;
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  right: 0; /* Move to right side */
  margin-right: 0;
  transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

#actual-canvas {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, #ffffff 0%, #f8fafc 100%);
  position: relative;
  border-radius: 0px;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.preview-fullscreen #scene-area {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  right: 0;
  z-index: 10000;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
}

.preview-fullscreen #canvas-wrapper {
  transform: scale(1);
  margin: auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  position: relative;
  right: auto;
}

.preview-fullscreen #actual-canvas {
  margin: auto;
  border-radius: 0;
}

.preview-fullscreen #actual-canvas img {
  pointer-events: auto;       /* still clickable */
  user-select: none;          /* can't select */
  cursor: default !important; /* no move/pointer/crosshair */
}

.selectable {
  cursor: pointer;
}

.selectable.selected {
  outline: 3px dashed purple;
  outline-offset: 2px;
  position: relative;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px 2px purple;
}

.preview-fullscreen #actual-canvas img {
  pointer-events: auto;
  user-select: none;
  cursor: default !important;
}

.sidebar-button, .page-button, #corner-button, .popup-btn {
  pointer-events: auto !important;
  user-select: auto !important;
}

img.selectable {
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-drag: none;
}

#code-popup {
  position: fixed;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, #ffffff 0%, #f8fafc 100%);
  padding: 35px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
  z-index: 3000;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 20px;
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  width: 650px;
  max-width: 95vw;
  max-height: 90vh;
  overflow-y: auto;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}


<div id="image-visuals-popup">
<div class="popup-title">Image Visuals</div>

<div class="visuals-section">
<div class="visuals-grid">
<div class="visual-control">
<label>Brightness</label>
<input type="range" id="brightness" min="0" max="200" value="100">
<span id="brightness-value">100%</span>
</div>

<div class="visual-control">
<label>Contrast</label>
<input type="range" id="contrast" min="0" max="200" value="100">
<span id="contrast-value">100%</span>
</div>

<div class="visual-control">
<label>Saturation</label>
<input type="range" id="saturation" min="0" max="200" value="100">
<span id="saturation-value">100%</span>
</div>

<div class="visual-control">
<label>Hue Rotation</label>
<input type="range" id="hue-rotate" min="0" max="360" value="0">
<span id="hue-rotate-value">0°</span>
</div>

<div class="visual-control">
<label>Grayscale</label>
<input type="range" id="grayscale" min="0" max="100" value="0">
<span id="grayscale-value">0%</span>
</div>

<div class="visual-control">
<label>Sepia</label>
<input type="range" id="sepia" min="0" max="100" value="0">
<span id="sepia-value">0%</span>
</div>

<div class="visual-control">
<label>Invert</label>
<input type="range" id="invert" min="0" max="100" value="0">
<span id="invert-value">0%</span>
</div>

<div class="visual-control">
<label>Blur</label>
<input type="range" id="blur" min="0" max="10" value="0" step="0.1">
<span id="blur-value">0px</span>
</div>

<div class="visual-control">
<label>Opacity</label>
<input type="range" id="opacity" min="0" max="100" value="100">
<span id="opacity-value">100%</span>
</div>

<div class="visual-control">
<label>Tint Color</label>
<input type="color" id="tint-color" value="#ffffff">
<input type="range" id="tint-opacity" min="0" max="100" value="0">
<span id="tint-opacity-value">0%</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="tools-section">
<h3 style="margin: 0 0 15px 0; color: #2d3748;">Drawing Tools</h3>
<div class="tools-grid">
<button class="tool-button" data-tool="select">Select</button>
<button class="tool-button" data-tool="glow">Glow Draw</button>
<button class="tool-button" data-tool="shadow">Shadow Draw</button>
<button class="tool-button" data-tool="eraser">Eraser</button>
</div>

<div class="tool-controls">
<div class="visual-control">
<label>Tool Size</label>
<input type="range" id="tool-size" min="1" max="50" value="10">
<span id="tool-size-value">10px</span>
</div>

<div class="visual-control">
<label>Tool Intensity</label>
<input type="range" id="tool-intensity" min="0" max="100" value="50">
<span id="tool-intensity-value">50%</span>
</div>

<div class="visual-control">
<label>Tool Color</label>
<input type="color" id="tool-color" value="#ffffff">
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="popup-buttons">
<button class="popup-btn cancel" onclick="closeImageVisualsPopup()">Cancel</button>
<button class="popup-btn" onclick="applyImageVisuals()">Apply</button>
</div>
</div>

#code-popup textarea {
  width: 100%;
  height: 320px;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 18px;
  font-family: 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 14px;
  resize: none;
  background: #f8fafc;
  color: #2d3748;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

#code-popup textarea:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: #667eea;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.1);
}

.code-popup-button {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
  color: white;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 12px 24px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.3);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.code-popup-button:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.4);
}

#textbox-popup-title {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
  color: white;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 15px 25px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.3);
  text-align: center;
  width: 100%;
}

#file-tab {
  width: 80%;
  height: 90px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4a5568 0%, #2d3748 100%);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  color: white;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  position: relative;
  z-index: 200; /* Higher than everything else - always on top */
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  margin-top: 10px;
  transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  border-radius: 8px;
}

#file-tab:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.4);
}

/* NEW SLIDING FILE MENU STYLES */
#file-sliding-menu {
  position: fixed;
  top: 10px;
  left: 34px; /* Start from behind the file button */
  height: 90px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4a5568 0%, #2d3748 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  z-index: 50; /* Lower than file tab - stays behind */
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  transform: translateX(0); /* Start at the same position as file button */
  transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), width 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  width: 136px; /* Same width as file button initially */
}

#file-sliding-menu.open {
  transform: translateX(120px); /* Slide out to the right */
  width: 1005px; /* Expand to fit all items horizontally */
}

.file-menu-item {
  height: 70px;
  min-width: 90px;
  padding: 0 15px;
  text-align: center;
  color: white;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  border-right: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(-20px);
  position: relative;
}

#file-sliding-menu.open .file-menu-item {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateX(0);
}

#file-sliding-menu.open .file-menu-item:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.1s; }
#file-sliding-menu.open .file-menu-item:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
#file-sliding-menu.open .file-menu-item:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.2s; }
#file-sliding-menu.open .file-menu-item:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
#file-sliding-menu.open .file-menu-item:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.3s; }
#file-sliding-menu.open .file-menu-item:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
#file-sliding-menu.open .file-menu-item:nth-child(7) { transition-delay: 0.4s; }
#file-sliding-menu.open .file-menu-item:nth-child(8) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
#file-sliding-menu.open .file-menu-item:nth-child(9) { transition-delay: 0.5s; }
#file-sliding-menu.open .file-menu-item:nth-child(10) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }
#file-sliding-menu.open .file-menu-item:nth-child(11) { transition-delay: 0.6s; }

.file-menu-item:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.file-menu-item:last-child {
  border-right: none;
}

/* Overlay to close menu when clicking outside */
#file-menu-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: transparent;
  z-index: 49; /* Lower than menu */
  display: none;
  pointer-events: none; /* Don't interfere with menu interactions */
}

#file-menu-overlay.active {
  display: block;
  pointer-events: auto; /* Only active when menu is open */
}

.file-dropdown-item {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 12px 0;
  text-align: center;
  color: white;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4a5568 0%, #2d3748 100%);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.file-dropdown-item:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
  transform: translateX(2px);
}

.file-dropdown-item:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}

.sidebar-button,
.sidebar-button * {
  user-select: none;
}

/* Modified: Allow dragging for page buttons but prevent for other bottom bar elements */
#bottom-bar {
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-drag: none;
}

#bottom-bar *:not(.page-button) {
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-drag: none;
}

#corner-box,
#corner-box * {
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-drag: none;
}

#file-tab {
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-drag: none;
}

#page-label {
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-drag: none;
}

.page-button.drag-over {
  border: 2px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.6);
}

#actual-canvas {
  position: relative;
}

.resize-bar {
  position: absolute;
  background: transparent !important;
  z-index: 1000;
  opacity: 0; /* full invisibility */
}

.resize-top, .resize-bottom {
  height: 6px;
  width: 100%;
  left: 0;
  cursor: ns-resize;
}
.resize-top { top: -3px; }
.resize-bottom { bottom: -3px; }

.resize-left, .resize-right {
  width: 6px;
  height: 100%;
  top: 0;
  cursor: ew-resize;
}
.resize-left { left: -3px; }
.resize-right { right: -3px; }

body[data-has-cursor-image="true"].in-preview-mode * {
  cursor: none !important;
}

#scroll-buttons {
  overflow-y: auto;
  flex-grow: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  width: 100%;
  padding-top: 10px;
}

let selectedPageForDelete = null;
let interactionMode = null; // 'move' | 'scale' | 'rotate'
let isMouseDown = false;
let copiedButtonLayout = null;
let savedTextboxLayout = null;
if (!pages[currentPage]) pages[currentPage] = [];
if (!pages[currentPage].meta) pages[currentPage].meta = {};
let inPreviewMode = false;
let justInteracted = false;
let remainingAssignedImages = (pages[currentPage]?.meta?.textboxConfig?.assignedNames || []).length;
let resizing = false;
let resizeSide = null;
let copiedElement = null;
let startX, startY, startWidth, startHeight, startLeft, startTop;
let actionHistory = [];
let redoHistory = [];
let maxHistorySize = 20; // Limit history to prevent memory issues
let savedEventListeners = [];
let globalImages = [];
let initialMouseX = 0;
let initialMouseY = 0;
let initialScale = 1;
let initialRotation = 0;
let initialDistance = 0;
let initialAngle = 0;
let isCtrlPressed = false;
let rotationDisplay = null;
let currentEditingImage = null;
let currentTool = 'select';
let originalImageFilters = {};
// Zoom and pan variables
const ZOOM_CONFIG = {
  min: 0.1,
  max: 10,
  step: 0.1,
  keyboardStep: 0.2,
  sensitivity: 0.001,
  smoothness: 0.15
};

let canvasZoom = 1;
let canvasPanX = 0;
let canvasPanY = 0;
let isPanning = false;
let lastPanX = 0;
let lastPanY = 0;
let zoomIndicatorTimeout;
let isPanningWithMiddle = false;
let isPanningWithRight = false;

function showRotationDisplay(element, rotation) {
  // Remove existing display
  if (rotationDisplay) {
    rotationDisplay.remove();
  }
  
  // Create rotation display
  rotationDisplay = document.createElement('div');
  rotationDisplay.style.position = 'absolute';
  rotationDisplay.style.background = 'linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%)';
  rotationDisplay.style.color = 'white';
  rotationDisplay.style.padding = '8px 16px';
  rotationDisplay.style.borderRadius = '20px';
  rotationDisplay.style.fontSize = '14px';
  rotationDisplay.style.fontWeight = '600';
  rotationDisplay.style.zIndex = '10000';
  rotationDisplay.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  rotationDisplay.style.boxShadow = '0 4px 15px rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.3)';
  rotationDisplay.style.border = '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)';
  rotationDisplay.style.backdropFilter = 'blur(10px)';
  rotationDisplay.textContent = `${Math.round(rotation)}°`;
  
  // Position above the element
  const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
  rotationDisplay.style.left = (rect.left + rect.width / 2 - 30) + 'px';
  rotationDisplay.style.top = (rect.top - 50) + 'px';
  
  document.body.appendChild(rotationDisplay);
}

function hideRotationDisplay() {
  if (rotationDisplay) {
    rotationDisplay.remove();
    rotationDisplay = null;
  }
}

function snapToInterval(angle, interval = 15) {
  return Math.round(angle / interval) * interval;
}


function toggleSlidingFileMenu() {
  const menu = document.getElementById('file-sliding-menu');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('file-menu-overlay');
  
  if (isFileMenuOpen) {
    closeSlidingFileMenu();
  } else {
    openSlidingFileMenu();
  }
}

function openSlidingFileMenu() {
  const menu = document.getElementById('file-sliding-menu');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('file-menu-overlay');
  
  menu.classList.add('open');
  overlay.classList.add('active');
  isFileMenuOpen = true;
}

function closeSlidingFileMenu() {
  const menu = document.getElementById('file-sliding-menu');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('file-menu-overlay');
  
  menu.classList.remove('open');
  overlay.classList.remove('active');
  isFileMenuOpen = false;
}

function saveAs() {
  alert('Save As clicked');
  closeSlidingFileMenu();
}

function saveFile() {
  alert('Save clicked');
  closeSlidingFileMenu();
}

  closeSlidingFileMenu();
}

function openFile() {
  alert('Open clicked');
  closeSlidingFileMenu();
}

function shareFile() {
  alert('Share clicked');
  closeSlidingFileMenu();
}


function saveState() {
  const state = {
    canvas: document.getElementById("actual-canvas").innerHTML,
    pages: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(pages)),
    currentPage: currentPage,
    totalPages: totalPages
  };
  
  actionHistory.push(state);
  
  // Clear redo history when a new action is performed
  redoHistory = [];
  
  // Limit history size
  if (actionHistory.length > maxHistorySize) {
    actionHistory.shift();
  }
}

// Updated undo function
function undoLastAction() {
  if (actionHistory.length === 0) return;

  // Save current state to redo history before undoing
  const currentState = {
    canvas: document.getElementById("actual-canvas").innerHTML,
    pages: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(pages)),
    currentPage: currentPage,
    totalPages: totalPages
  };
  redoHistory.push(currentState);

  const canvas = document.getElementById("actual-canvas");
  const previousState = actionHistory.pop();
  
  // Restore canvas content
  canvas.innerHTML = previousState.canvas;
  
  // Restore page data
  pages = previousState.pages;
  currentPage = previousState.currentPage;
  totalPages = previousState.totalPages;
  
  // Clear selection
  selectedElement = null;
  removeResizeBars();
  
  // CRITICAL: Rebind events for all elements
  rebindElementEvents();
  renderPageButtons();
  updatePageLabel();
}

// Updated redo function
function redoLastAction() {
  if (redoHistory.length === 0) return;

  // Save current state to action history before redoing
  const currentState = {
    canvas: document.getElementById("actual-canvas").innerHTML,
    pages: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(pages)),
    currentPage: currentPage,
    totalPages: totalPages
  };
  actionHistory.push(currentState);

  const canvas = document.getElementById("actual-canvas");
  const nextState = redoHistory.pop();
  
  // Restore canvas content
  canvas.innerHTML = nextState.canvas;
  
  // Restore page data
  pages = nextState.pages;
  currentPage = nextState.currentPage;
  totalPages = nextState.totalPages;
  
  // Clear selection
  selectedElement = null;
  removeResizeBars();
  
  // CRITICAL: Rebind events for all elements
  rebindElementEvents();
  renderPageButtons();
  updatePageLabel();
}

function clearGuides() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.guide-line').forEach(g => g.remove());
}

function showGuideLine(x, y) {
  const canvas = document.getElementById("actual-canvas");
  const canvasRect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

  if (y !== null) {
    const h = document.createElement("div");
    h.className = "guide-line h";
    h.style.top = ((y - canvasRect.top) / canvasRect.height) * 100 + "%";
    canvas.appendChild(h);
  }
  if (x !== null) {
    const v = document.createElement("div");
    v.className = "guide-line v";
    v.style.left = ((x - canvasRect.left) / canvasRect.width) * 100 + "%";
    canvas.appendChild(v);
  }
}

function getScale(el) {
  const match = el.style.transform.match(/scale\(([^)]+)\)/);
  return match ? parseFloat(match[1]) : 1;
}

function getRotation(el) {
  const match = el.style.transform.match(/rotate\(([^)]+)deg\)/);
  return match ? parseFloat(match[1]) : 0;
}

function isClickOnOpaquePixel(img, event, callback) {
  if (!img.complete || img.naturalWidth === 0) {
    img.onload = () => isClickOnOpaquePixel(img, event, callback);
    return;
  }

  const rect = img.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = event.clientX - rect.left;
  const y = event.clientY - rect.top;

  const scaleX = img.naturalWidth / rect.width;
  const scaleY = img.naturalHeight / rect.height;
  const pixelX = Math.floor(x * scaleX);
  const pixelY = Math.floor(y * scaleY);

  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = img.naturalWidth;
  canvas.height = img.naturalHeight;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);

  try {
    const alpha = ctx.getImageData(pixelX, pixelY, 1, 1).data[3];
    if (alpha > 0) callback();
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Pixel check failed:', err);
    callback();
  }
}

function addResizeBars(el) {
  removeResizeBars();

  const sides = ['top', 'right', 'bottom', 'left'];
  sides.forEach(side => {
    const bar = document.createElement('div');
    bar.className = `resize-bar resize-${side}`;
    bar.dataset.side = side;
    el.appendChild(bar);
  });
}

function removeResizeBars() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.resize-bar').forEach(bar => bar.remove());
}

// Helper function to check if element should participate in snapping
function isSnappableElement(el) {
  // Exclude images from snapping
  if (el.tagName === 'IMG' || el.classList.contains('image-preview')) {
    return false;
  }
  return el.classList.contains('selectable') || 
         el.classList.contains('selectable-button') ||
         el.classList.contains('selectable-textbox');
}

// Enhanced snapping logic with canvas center support
function applySnapGuides(selectedElement) {
  clearGuides();
  
  const canvas = document.getElementById('actual-canvas');
  const canvasRect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  
  const get = (el, prop) => parseFloat(el.style[prop] || 0);
  
  const b1 = {
    top: get(selectedElement, 'top'),
    left: get(selectedElement, 'left'),
    width: get(selectedElement, 'width'),
    height: get(selectedElement, 'height'),
  };
  
  const cX1 = b1.left + b1.width / 2;
  const cY1 = b1.top + b1.height / 2;
  
  const threshold = 0.5;
  let snapped = false;
  
  // Canvas center snapping (50% marks)
  const canvasCenterX = 50;
  const canvasCenterY = 50;
  
  // Snap to canvas center X
  if (Math.abs(cX1 - canvasCenterX) < threshold) {
    selectedElement.style.left = (canvasCenterX - b1.width / 2) + "%";
    showGuideLine(canvasRect.left + canvasRect.width / 2, null);
    snapped = true;
  }
  
  // Snap to canvas center Y
  if (Math.abs(cY1 - canvasCenterY) < threshold) {
    selectedElement.style.top = (canvasCenterY - b1.height / 2) + "%";
    showGuideLine(null, canvasRect.top + canvasRect.height / 2);
    snapped = true;
  }
  
  // Element-to-element snapping
  document.querySelectorAll('#actual-canvas *').forEach(otherEl => {
    if (otherEl === selectedElement || !isSnappableElement(otherEl)) return;
    
    const b2 = {
      top: get(otherEl, 'top'),
      left: get(otherEl, 'left'),
      width: get(otherEl, 'width'),
      height: get(otherEl, 'height'),
    };
    
    const cX2 = b2.left + b2.width / 2;
    const cY2 = b2.top + b2.height / 2;
    
    const rect2 = otherEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    const rCenterX = rect2.left + rect2.width / 2;
    const rCenterY = rect2.top + rect2.height / 2;
    
    // Vertical snapping (X-axis)
    if (Math.abs(b1.left - b2.left) < threshold) {
      selectedElement.style.left = b2.left + "%";
      showGuideLine(rect2.left, null);
      snapped = true;
    }
    if (Math.abs(b1.left + b1.width - (b2.left + b2.width)) < threshold) {
      selectedElement.style.left = (b2.left + b2.width - b1.width) + "%";
      showGuideLine(rect2.right, null);
      snapped = true;
    }
    if (Math.abs(cX1 - cX2) < threshold) {
      selectedElement.style.left = (cX2 - b1.width / 2) + "%";
      showGuideLine(rCenterX, null);
      snapped = true;
    }
    
    // Horizontal snapping (Y-axis)
    if (Math.abs(b1.top - b2.top) < threshold) {
      selectedElement.style.top = b2.top + "%";
      showGuideLine(null, rect2.top);
      snapped = true;
    }
    if (Math.abs(b1.top + b1.height - (b2.top + b2.height)) < threshold) {
      selectedElement.style.top = (b2.top + b2.height - b1.height) + "%";
      showGuideLine(null, rect2.bottom);
      snapped = true;
    }
    if (Math.abs(cY1 - cY2) < threshold) {
      selectedElement.style.top = (cY2 - b1.height / 2) + "%";
      showGuideLine(null, rCenterY);
      snapped = true;
    }
    
    // Edge-to-edge snapping
    if (Math.abs(b1.left + b1.width - b2.left) < threshold) {
      selectedElement.style.left = (b2.left - b1.width) + "%";
      showGuideLine(rect2.left, null);
      snapped = true;
    }
    if (Math.abs(b1.left - (b2.left + b2.width)) < threshold) {
      selectedElement.style.left = (b2.left + b2.width) + "%";
      showGuideLine(rect2.right, null);
      snapped = true;
    }
    if (Math.abs(b1.top + b1.height - b2.top) < threshold) {
      selectedElement.style.top = (b2.top - b1.height) + "%";
      showGuideLine(null, rect2.top);
      snapped = true;
    }
    if (Math.abs(b1.top - (b2.top + b2.height)) < threshold) {
      selectedElement.style.top = (b2.top + b2.height) + "%";
      showGuideLine(null, rect2.bottom);
      snapped = true;
    }
  });
}


// Add this missing function to rebind all event listeners after undo/redo
function rebindElementEvents() {
  // Rebind image click events
  document.querySelectorAll('#actual-canvas img.selectable').forEach(img => {
    // Remove any existing listeners to prevent duplicates
    img.replaceWith(img.cloneNode(true));
    const newImg = document.querySelector(`#actual-canvas img[src="${img.src}"]`);
    
    // Rebind the double-click event for naming
    newImg.addEventListener("dblclick", function(e) {
      if (this.classList.contains("selectable")) {
        openNamePopupForImage(this);
      }
    });
    
    // Rebind click event for selection
    newImg.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
      if (!inPreviewMode && !justInteracted) {
      // Add double-click to open visuals popup
newImg.addEventListener("contextmenu", function(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (!inPreviewMode) {
    openImageVisualsPopup(this);
  }
});
        // Handle image transparency check if needed
        if (this.style.clipPath || this.dataset.hasTransparency === 'true') {
          isClickOnOpaquePixel(this, e, () => {
            document.querySelectorAll(".selected").forEach(el => el.classList.remove("selected"));
            removeResizeBars();
            selectedElement = this;
            this.classList.add("selected");
            addResizeBars(this);
            e.stopPropagation();
          });
        } else {
          document.querySelectorAll(".selected").forEach(el => el.classList.remove("selected"));
          removeResizeBars();
          selectedElement = this;
          this.classList.add("selected");
          addResizeBars(this);
          e.stopPropagation();
        }
      }
    });
  });
  
  // Rebind textbox double-click events
  document.querySelectorAll('#actual-canvas .selectable[data-box-type="textbox"]').forEach(textbox => {
    textbox.addEventListener("dblclick", function(e) {
      if (this.classList.contains("selectable") && this.dataset.boxType === 'textbox') {
        openTextboxEditorGUI(this);
      }
    });
  });
  
  // Rebind button events if you have any
  document.querySelectorAll('#actual-canvas .selectable-button').forEach(button => {
    // Add any specific button event handlers here
  });
}

function clampZoom(zoom) {
  return Math.max(ZOOM_CONFIG.min, Math.min(ZOOM_CONFIG.max, zoom));
}

function showZoomIndicator() {
  const indicator = document.getElementById('zoom-indicator');
  indicator.textContent = Math.round(canvasZoom * 100) + '%';
  indicator.style.opacity = '1';
  
  clearTimeout(zoomIndicatorTimeout);
  zoomIndicatorTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
    indicator.style.opacity = '0';
  }, 1500);
}

function updateCanvasTransform(smooth = true) {
  const canvasWrapper = document.getElementById('canvas-wrapper');
  if (canvasWrapper) {
    canvasWrapper.style.transformOrigin = '0 0';
    canvasWrapper.style.transition = smooth ? `transform ${ZOOM_CONFIG.smoothness}s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)` : 'none';
    canvasWrapper.style.transform = `translate(${canvasPanX}px, ${canvasPanY}px) scale(${canvasZoom})`;
  }
  showZoomIndicator();
}

function resetCanvasView() {
  canvasZoom = 1;
  canvasPanX = 0;
  canvasPanY = 0;
  updateCanvasTransform();
}

function zoomToPoint(mouseX, mouseY, newZoom, smooth = true) {
  // Calculate the point in canvas coordinates before zoom
  const canvasPointX = (mouseX - canvasPanX) / canvasZoom;
  const canvasPointY = (mouseY - canvasPanY) / canvasZoom;
  
  // Apply new zoom
  canvasZoom = clampZoom(newZoom);
  
  // Adjust pan to keep the same point under the mouse
  canvasPanX = mouseX - (canvasPointX * canvasZoom);
  canvasPanY = mouseY - (canvasPointY * canvasZoom);
  
  updateCanvasTransform(smooth);
}

function zoomToFit() {
  const windowWidth = window.innerWidth - 170; // Account for left sidebar
  const windowHeight = window.innerHeight - 100; // Account for bottom bar
  const canvasWidth = 1365;
  const canvasHeight = window.innerHeight - 100;
  
  const scaleX = windowWidth / canvasWidth;
  const scaleY = windowHeight / canvasHeight;
  const optimalZoom = Math.min(scaleX, scaleY) * 0.9; // 90% of optimal for padding
  
  canvasZoom = clampZoom(optimalZoom);
  canvasPanX = 0;
  canvasPanY = 0;
  updateCanvasTransform();
}

document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.ctrlKey && e.shiftKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === "z") {
    e.preventDefault();
    redoLastAction();
  } else if (e.ctrlKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === "z") {
    e.preventDefault();
    undoLastAction();
  }
});

document.getElementById("actual-canvas").addEventListener("dblclick", function (e) {
  if (e.target.tagName === "IMG" && e.target.classList.contains("selectable")) {
    openNamePopupForImage(e.target);
  }
});

document.getElementById("actual-canvas").addEventListener("dblclick", function (e) {
  if (e.target.classList.contains("selectable") && e.target.dataset.boxType === 'textbox') {
    openTextboxEditorGUI(e.target);
  }
});

document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  if (inPreviewMode) {
    if (selectedElement) {
      selectedElement.classList.remove("selected");
      selectedElement = null;
    }
    return;
  }

  if (justInteracted) return;

  // Always clear any existing selections
  document.querySelectorAll(".selected").forEach(el => el.classList.remove("selected"));
  removeResizeBars();
  selectedElement = null;

  // Select new element if applicable
  if (isSnappableElement(e.target)) {
    selectedElement = e.target;
    selectedElement.classList.add("selected");
    addResizeBars(selectedElement);
    e.stopPropagation();
  }
});

document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  const key = e.key.toLowerCase();

  if (key === "escape") {
    exitPreview();
    return;
  }

  if (inPreviewMode) return;

  if (selectedElement) {
    if (key === "m") interactionMode = "move";
    if (key === "r") interactionMode = "rotate";
    if (key === "s") interactionMode = "scale";
  }

  if ((key === "delete" || key === "backspace") && selectedPageForDelete !== null) {
    saveState();
    deleteCurrentPage();
    return;
  }

  if (key === "delete" && selectedElement) {
    const popupVisible = document.getElementById("button-popup");
    if (!popupVisible || getComputedStyle(popupVisible).display === "none") {
      if (confirm("Do you want to delete this element?")) {
        saveState();
        const index = pages[currentPage].indexOf(selectedElement);
        if (index !== -1) pages[currentPage].splice(index, 1);
        selectedElement.remove();
        selectedElement = null;
        removeResizeBars();
      }
    }
  }

  if (e.ctrlKey && e.shiftKey && key === "z") {
    e.preventDefault();
    redoLastAction();
  } else if (e.ctrlKey && key === "z") {
    e.preventDefault();
    undoLastAction();
  }
});

document.getElementById("canvas-wrapper").addEventListener("click", function (e) {
  if (!justInteracted && (e.target.id === "canvas-wrapper" || e.target.id === "actual-canvas")) {
    document.querySelectorAll(".selectable").forEach((el) => el.classList.remove("selected"));
    selectedElement = null;
    removeResizeBars();
  }
});

document.addEventListener("mousedown", function (e) {
  if (inPreviewMode) return;

  if (interactionMode === null && selectedElement && e.target === selectedElement) {
    interactionMode = "move";
  }

  if (!selectedElement || !["move", "scale", "rotate"].includes(interactionMode)) return;

  saveState();
  isMouseDown = true;
  justInteracted = true;
  
  // Store initial mouse position
  initialMouseX = e.clientX;
  initialMouseY = e.clientY;
  
  // Store initial element state for scaling and rotation
  if (interactionMode === "scale" || interactionMode === "rotate") {
    initialScale = getScale(selectedElement);
    initialRotation = getRotation(selectedElement);
    
    // Calculate initial distance and angle from element center
    const box = selectedElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    const centerX = box.left + box.width / 2;
    const centerY = box.top + box.height / 2;
    
    initialDistance = Math.hypot(e.clientX - centerX, e.clientY - centerY);
    initialAngle = Math.atan2(e.clientY - centerY, e.clientX - centerX) * (180 / Math.PI);
  }
});

document.addEventListener("mouseup", function () {
  if (["move", "scale", "rotate"].includes(interactionMode)) {
    isMouseDown = false;
    interactionMode = null;
    clearGuides();
    hideRotationDisplay(); // Hide rotation display when done
    setTimeout(() => { justInteracted = false; }, 50);
  }
});

document.addEventListener("mousemove", function (e) {
  if (inPreviewMode) return;
  if (!selectedElement || !isMouseDown || !["move", "scale", "rotate"].includes(interactionMode)) return;
  
  const canvas = document.getElementById("actual-canvas");
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  
  if (interactionMode === "move") {
    const el = selectedElement;
    const canvasWidth = rect.width;
    const canvasHeight = rect.height;

    const offsetX = (e.movementX / canvasWidth) * 100;
    const offsetY = (e.movementY / canvasHeight) * 100;
    
    let currentLeft = parseFloat(el.style.left);
    let currentTop = parseFloat(el.style.top);

    if (isNaN(currentLeft) || isNaN(currentTop)) {
      const elRect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      const canvasRect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      currentLeft = ((elRect.left - canvasRect.left) / canvasRect.width) * 100;
      currentTop = ((elRect.top - canvasRect.top) / canvasRect.height) * 100;
    }

    let newLeft = currentLeft + offsetX;
    let newTop = currentTop + offsetY;

// Get the current scale factor
const currentScale = getScale(el);

// Calculate the actual visual dimensions accounting for scale
const baseWidth = (el.offsetWidth / canvasWidth) * 100;
const baseHeight = (el.offsetHeight / canvasHeight) * 100;
const visualWidth = baseWidth * currentScale;
const visualHeight = baseHeight * currentScale;

// Calculate the offset caused by scaling from center (transform-origin: 50% 50%)
const scaleOffsetX = (baseWidth - visualWidth) / 2;
const scaleOffsetY = (baseHeight - visualHeight) / 2;

// Adjust the visual bounds accounting for scale offset
const visualLeft = newLeft + scaleOffsetX;
const visualTop = newTop + scaleOffsetY;
const visualRight = visualLeft + visualWidth;
const visualBottom = visualTop + visualHeight;

const snapThreshold = 1;

// Canvas edge snapping using visual bounds
if (Math.abs(visualLeft) < snapThreshold) {
  newLeft = -scaleOffsetX;
} else if (Math.abs(visualRight - 100) < snapThreshold) {
  newLeft = 100 - visualWidth - scaleOffsetX;
}

if (Math.abs(visualTop) < snapThreshold) {
  newTop = -scaleOffsetY;
} else if (Math.abs(visualBottom - 100) < snapThreshold) {
  newTop = 100 - visualHeight - scaleOffsetY;
}

    el.style.left = `${newLeft}%`;
    el.style.top = `${newTop}%`;
    
    // Apply enhanced snapping (only if not an image)
    if (selectedElement.tagName !== 'IMG' && !selectedElement.classList.contains('image-preview')) {
      applySnapGuides(selectedElement);
    }
  }
  
  if (interactionMode === "scale") {
    const box = selectedElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    const centerX = box.left + box.width / 2;
    const centerY = box.top + box.height / 2;
    
    // Calculate current distance from center
    const currentDistance = Math.hypot(e.clientX - centerX, e.clientY - centerY);
    
    // Calculate scale change based on distance change from initial
    const distanceChange = currentDistance - initialDistance;
    const scaleChange = distanceChange / 150; // Adjust sensitivity here
    const newScale = Math.max(0.05, initialScale + scaleChange);
    
    selectedElement.style.transform = `scale(${newScale}) rotate(${getRotation(selectedElement)}deg)`;
  }
  
if (interactionMode === "rotate") {
  const box = selectedElement.getBoundingClientRect();
  const centerX = box.left + box.width / 2;
  const centerY = box.top + box.height / 2;
  
  // Calculate current angle from center
  const currentAngle = Math.atan2(e.clientY - centerY, e.clientX - centerX) * (180 / Math.PI);
  
  // Calculate rotation change from initial angle
  const angleChange = currentAngle - initialAngle;
  let newRotation = initialRotation + angleChange;
  
  // Apply snapping if Ctrl is held down
  if (isCtrlPressed) {
    newRotation = snapToInterval(newRotation, 15);
  }
  
  // Show rotation display
  showRotationDisplay(selectedElement, newRotation);
  
  selectedElement.style.transform = `rotate(${newRotation}deg) scale(${getScale(selectedElement)})`;
}
});

document.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
  if (e.target.classList.contains("resize-bar")) {
    resizing = true;
    resizeSide = e.target.dataset.side;
    selectedElement = e.target.parentElement;
    e.preventDefault();

    saveState(); // Save state before resizing

    const rect = selectedElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    const canvasRect = document.getElementById("actual-canvas").getBoundingClientRect();
    startX = e.clientX;
    startY = e.clientY;
    startWidth = rect.width;
    startHeight = rect.height;
    startLeft = rect.left - canvasRect.left;
    startTop = rect.top - canvasRect.top;
    
    justInteracted = true;
  }
});

document.addEventListener("mouseup", () => {
  if (resizing) {
    resizing = false;
    clearGuides();
    setTimeout(() => { justInteracted = false; }, 50);
  }
  hideRotationDisplay(); // Also hide when resizing ends
  resizeSide = null;
});

document.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
  if (!resizing || !selectedElement) return;

  const canvas = document.getElementById("actual-canvas");
  const canvasRect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const percent = (val, total) => (val / total) * 100;

  const dx = e.clientX - startX;
  const dy = e.clientY - startY;

  const applyScalingSnapGuides = () => {
    clearGuides();
    const get = (el, prop) => parseFloat(el.style[prop] || 0);
    const b1 = {
      top: get(selectedElement, 'top'),
      left: get(selectedElement, 'left'),
      width: get(selectedElement, 'width'),
      height: get(selectedElement, 'height'),
    };

    document.querySelectorAll('#actual-canvas *').forEach(otherEl => {
      if (otherEl === selectedElement || !isSnappableElement(otherEl)) return;

      const b2 = {
        top: get(otherEl, 'top'),
        left: get(otherEl, 'left'),
        width: get(otherEl, 'width'),
        height: get(otherEl, 'height'),
      };

      const cX1 = b1.left + b1.width / 2;
      const cX2 = b2.left + b2.width / 2;
      const cY1 = b1.top + b1.height / 2;
      const cY2 = b2.top + b2.height / 2;

      const rect2 = otherEl.getBoundingClientRect();
      const rCenterX = rect2.left + rect2.width / 2;
      const rCenterY = rect2.top + rect2.height / 2;
      const threshold = 0.5;

      // All the existing scaling snap logic...
      if (Math.abs(b1.left - b2.left) < threshold && resizeSide === "left") {
        const diff = b1.left - b2.left;
        selectedElement.style.left = b2.left + "%";
        selectedElement.style.width = (b1.width + diff) + "%";
        showGuideLine(rect2.left, null);
      }

      if (Math.abs(b1.left + b1.width - (b2.left + b2.width)) < threshold && resizeSide === "right") {
        selectedElement.style.width = (b2.left + b2.width - b1.left) + "%";
        showGuideLine(rect2.right, null);
      }

      if (Math.abs(cX1 - cX2) < threshold) {
        const diff = cX1 - cX2;
        if (resizeSide === "left") {
          selectedElement.style.left = (b1.left - diff) + "%";
          selectedElement.style.width = (b1.width + diff) + "%";
        } else if (resizeSide === "right") {
          selectedElement.style.width = (b1.width - diff) + "%";
        }
        showGuideLine(rCenterX, null);
      }

      if (Math.abs(b1.top - b2.top) < threshold && resizeSide === "top") {
        const diff = b1.top - b2.top;
        selectedElement.style.top = b2.top + "%";
        selectedElement.style.height = (b1.height + diff) + "%";
        showGuideLine(null, rect2.top);
      }

      if (Math.abs(b1.top + b1.height - (b2.top + b2.height)) < threshold && resizeSide === "bottom") {
        selectedElement.style.height = (b2.top + b2.height - b1.top) + "%";
        showGuideLine(null, rect2.bottom);
      }

      if (Math.abs(cY1 - cY2) < threshold) {
        const diff = cY1 - cY2;
        if (resizeSide === "top") {
          selectedElement.style.top = (b1.top - diff) + "%";
          selectedElement.style.height = (b1.height + diff) + "%";
        } else if (resizeSide === "bottom") {
          selectedElement.style.height = (b1.height - diff) + "%";
        }
        showGuideLine(null, rCenterY);
      }

      if (resizeSide === "left" && Math.abs(b1.left + b1.width - b2.left) < threshold) {
        selectedElement.style.width = (b2.left - b1.left) + "%";
        showGuideLine(rect2.left, null);
      }

      if (resizeSide === "top" && Math.abs(b1.top + b1.height - b2.top) < threshold) {
        selectedElement.style.height = (b2.top - b1.top) + "%";
        showGuideLine(null, rect2.top);
      }

      if (resizeSide === "left" && Math.abs(b1.left - (b2.left + b2.width)) < threshold) {
        const diff = b1.left - (b2.left + b2.width);
        selectedElement.style.left = (b2.left + b2.width) + "%";
        selectedElement.style.width = (b1.width + diff) + "%";
        showGuideLine(rect2.right, null);
      }

      if (resizeSide === "top" && Math.abs(b1.top - (b2.top + b2.height)) < threshold) {
        const diff = b1.top - (b2.top + b2.height);
        selectedElement.style.top = (b2.top + b2.height) + "%";
        selectedElement.style.height = (b1.height + diff) + "%";
        showGuideLine(null, rect2.bottom);
      }
    });
  };

  if (resizeSide === "left") {
    let newLeft = startLeft + dx;
    let newWidth = startWidth - dx;

    if (Math.abs(percent(newLeft, canvasRect.width)) < 1) {
      newLeft = 0;
      newWidth = startWidth + startLeft;
    }

    if (newWidth >= 20) {
      selectedElement.style.left = percent(newLeft, canvasRect.width) + "%";
      selectedElement.style.width = percent(newWidth, canvasRect.width) + "%";
      clearGuides();
      applyScalingSnapGuides();
    }
  }

  if (resizeSide === "right") {
    let newWidth = startWidth + dx;

    let rightEdge = startLeft + newWidth;
    if (Math.abs(percent(rightEdge, canvasRect.width) - 100) < 1) {
      newWidth = canvasRect.width - startLeft;
    }

    if (newWidth >= 20) {
      selectedElement.style.width = percent(newWidth, canvasRect.width) + "%";
      applyScalingSnapGuides();
    }
  }

  if (resizeSide === "top") {
    let newHeight = startHeight - dy;
    let newTop = startTop + dy;

    if (Math.abs(percent(newTop, canvasRect.height)) < 1) {
      newTop = 0;
      newHeight = startTop + startHeight;
    }

    if (newHeight >= 20) {
      selectedElement.style.top = percent(newTop, canvasRect.height) + "%";
      selectedElement.style.height = percent(newHeight, canvasRect.height) + "%";
      clearGuides();
      applyScalingSnapGuides();
    }
  }

  if (resizeSide === "bottom") {
    let newHeight = startHeight + dy;
    let snapped = false;

    const currentTop = parseFloat(selectedElement.style.top || "0");
    const newBottom = currentTop + percent(newHeight, canvasRect.height);

    if (Math.abs(newBottom - 100) < 1) {
      newHeight = (100 - currentTop) * canvasRect.height / 100;
      snapped = true;
    }

    if (newHeight >= 20) {
      selectedElement.style.height = percent(newHeight, canvasRect.height) + "%";
      applyScalingSnapGuides();
      if (snapped) showGuideLine(null, canvasRect.bottom);
    }
  }
});

document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.ctrlKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'c') {
    if (selectedElement) {
      copiedElement = selectedElement.cloneNode(true);
      copiedElement.classList.remove('selected');
    }
  }

  if (e.ctrlKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'v') {
    if (copiedElement && document.getElementById('actual-canvas')) {
      saveState();

      const newElement = copiedElement.cloneNode(true);
      newElement.style.left = (parseFloat(copiedElement.style.left || "0") + 2) + "%";
      newElement.style.top = (parseFloat(copiedElement.style.top || "0") + 2) + "%";
      document.getElementById('actual-canvas').appendChild(newElement);
      pages[currentPage].push(newElement);
    }
  }
});

document.getElementById('page-buttons').addEventListener('wheel', function (e) {
  if (e.deltaY !== 0) {
    e.preventDefault();
    this.scrollLeft += e.deltaY;
  }
});
renderPageButtons();
loadScene(currentPage);
updatePageLabel();
setupTrashCan();


// Close menu when pressing Escape key
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape' && isFileMenuOpen) {
    closeSlidingFileMenu();
  }
});

document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "Control") {
    isCtrlPressed = true;
  }
});

document.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "Control") {
    isCtrlPressed = false;
  }
});


// Zoom and Pan Event Listeners
const canvasWrapper = document.getElementById('canvas-wrapper');

// Professional wheel zoom handling
canvasWrapper.addEventListener('wheel', function(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  e.stopPropagation();
  
  // Get mouse position relative to the canvas
  const rect = canvasWrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
  const mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left;
  const mouseY = e.clientY - rect.top;
  
  // Calculate zoom delta with improved sensitivity
  const delta = -e.deltaY * ZOOM_CONFIG.sensitivity;
  const zoomFactor = Math.exp(delta);
  const newZoom = canvasZoom * zoomFactor;
  
  zoomToPoint(mouseX, mouseY, newZoom, false);
});

// Mouse panning setup
canvasWrapper.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
  if (e.button === 1) { // Middle mouse button
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    isPanningWithMiddle = true;
    lastPanX = e.clientX;
    lastPanY = e.clientY;
    document.body.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
  }
});

document.getElementById('actual-canvas').addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
  if (e.button === 2) { // Right mouse button
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    isPanningWithRight = true;
    isPanning = true;
    lastPanX = e.clientX;
    lastPanY = e.clientY;
    document.body.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
  }
});

document.getElementById('actual-canvas').addEventListener('contextmenu', function(e) {
  if (isPanningWithRight || isPanning) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
  }
});

document.addEventListener('mouseup', function(e) {
  if ((e.button === 2 && isPanningWithRight) || (e.button === 1 && isPanningWithMiddle)) {
    isPanningWithRight = false;
    isPanningWithMiddle = false;
    isPanning = false;
    document.body.style.cursor = '';
  }
});

document.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
  if (isPanningWithMiddle || isPanningWithRight) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    
    const deltaX = e.clientX - lastPanX;
    const deltaY = e.clientY - lastPanY;
    
    canvasPanX += deltaX;
    canvasPanY += deltaY;
    
    lastPanX = e.clientX;
    lastPanY = e.clientY;
    
    updateCanvasTransform(false);
    
    isPanning = true;
  }
});

// Enhanced keyboard zoom controls
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) {
    if (e.key === '=' || e.key === '+') {
      e.preventDefault();
      const rect = canvasWrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
      const centerX = rect.width / 2;
      const centerY = rect.height / 2;
      
      const newZoom = canvasZoom + ZOOM_CONFIG.keyboardStep;
      zoomToPoint(centerX, centerY, newZoom);
      
    } else if (e.key === '-') {
      e.preventDefault();
      const rect = canvasWrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
      const centerX = rect.width / 2;
      const centerY = rect.height / 2;
      
      const newZoom = canvasZoom - ZOOM_CONFIG.keyboardStep;
      zoomToPoint(centerX, centerY, newZoom);
      
    } else if (e.key === '0') {
      e.preventDefault();
      resetCanvasView();
    } else if (e.key === '9') {
      e.preventDefault();
      zoomToFit();
    }
  }
});

// Double-click to reset view
canvasWrapper.addEventListener('dblclick', function(e) {
  if (e.target === canvasWrapper || e.target === document.getElementById('actual-canvas')) {
    resetCanvasView();
  }
});

// Handle window resize
window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
  updateCanvasTransform(false);
});

// Initialize canvas transform
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  updateCanvasTransform();
});
</script>
